headline: Easy breeding chain: Sibelyx
title: Easy Sibelyx Breeding Chain in Palworld | 3 Steps From Easy Pals | Palworld Breeding Guide
video_script: Need Sibelyx for your base? Follow these three easy breeding steps. Step one: breed Tocotoco with Vanwyrm to get Dazemu. Step two: breed that Dazemu with Grintale to get Sweepa. Step three: breed that Sweepa with Incineram, and the egg hatches into Sibelyx! Every step is checked against Palworld one point zero breeding data. Put each pair on the Breeding Farm with a cake. Which Pal should I chain next? Comment below!
description: Easy 3-step Palworld 1.0 breeding chain to Sibelyx: Tocotoco + Vanwyrm = Dazemu, Dazemu + Grintale = Sweepa, Sweepa + Incineram = Sibelyx. Each step verified on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula from PinDrop's combi ranks.
